stories.title: In one week, war has swept across the Middle East
stories.summary: One week into the U.S.–Israeli bombing campaign against Iran, the conflict is already spilling far beyond its original battlefield — with shockwaves reaching from Cyprus to Sri Lanka.

stories.title: Political and religious leaders celebrate Jesse Jackson's life at 'homegoing' service
stories.summary: A celebration of the life of civil rights leader Jesse Jackson will be held in Chicago Friday. Current and former elected officials, faith leaders, entertainers and more are expected to attend. A private funeral will be held Saturday.

stories.title: As the war goes on in Iran, American-Iranians struggle to stay in touch with family
stories.summary: Many Iranians in the U.S. with family back in Iran have been having a very difficult time staying in touch as bombs continue to drop around the country. That's creating a lot of anxiety and worry.

stories.title: 'Peaky Blinders' is on the big screen in 'The Immortal Man'
stories.summary: After six seasons of streaming, Cillian Murphy's Tommy Shelby brings his Romani family of Birmingham gangsters to the big screen.

stories.title: Advocate for military families on what wartime deployment means at home
stories.summary: NPR's Juana Summers speaks with Kathy Roth-Douquet, CEO of Blue Star Families, about the challenges that military families face around deployment.

stories.title: How a handful of koalas are changing scientists understanding of genetic risk
stories.summary: It's long been assumed that koalas in southern Australia are genetically unhealthy. A new study finds they're actually recovering, changing how scientists look at genetic risks.
